section_summary.extract_value: This section presents a path analysis examining the role of body image-related cognitive fusion (CFQ_BI) and body appreciation (BAS-2) in the association between body image discrepancy (BID) and disordered eating attitudes/behaviors (EDE_Q), while controlling for BMI. The final model explained 67% of eating psychopathology variance, with body image discrepancy showing significant direct and indirect effects on disordered eating through both cognitive fusion and body appreciation mechanisms.
